title: SB422 (2020 Regular): Firearms - Permit to Carry, Wear, or Transport - Required Courses

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2020RS/bills/sb/sb0422f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader, as filed; no vote recorded.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5–306.1): (A) (1) EXCEPT AS PROVIDED IN PARAGRAPH (2) OF THIS SUBSECTION, A PERSON TO WHOM A PERMIT IS ISSUED OR RENEWED SHALL SUCCESSFULLY COMPLETE ON SEPARATE DAYS EACH CALENDAR YEAR: (I) A COURSE ON SITUATIONAL AWARENESS APPROVED BY THE SECRETARY; AND (II) A COURSE ON THE COMPETENT HANDLING OF A FIREARM APPROVED BY THE SECRETARY. (2) A PERSON TO WHOM A PERMIT IS ISSUED OR RENEWED IS NOT REQUIRED TO COMPLETE THE COURSES REQUIRED UNDER PARAGRAPH (1) OF THIS SUBSECTION IF THE PERSON IS: (I) AN ACTIVE LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICER WITH A LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENCY OF THE UNITED STATES, THE STATE, OR ANY LOCAL LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENCY IN THE STATE; OR (II) A QUALIFIED HANDGUN INSTRUCTOR. (B) THE SECRETARY MAY ADOPT REGULATIONS NECESSARY TO CARRY OUT THIS SECTION.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5–310): (a) The Secretary may revoke a permit on a finding that the holder: (1) does not meet the qualifications described in § 5–306 OR § 5–306.1 of this subtitle; or (2) violated § 5–308 of this subtitle.
